content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same issue. After renaming the project folder using Windows Explorer, I encountered errors. Restoring the original folder name resolved the problem, but I'm still unsure how to rename the folder without triggering an error.

As mentioned earlier, it is possible to rename a [product_name] Web Editor project folder and upload the project to the [product_name] device without issues, as long as correct naming conventions are followed.
I discovered the source of the problem: do not include a dot (.) in the project name! For example, 'Webserver_1_0' and 'Webserver 1 0' both work, but 'Webserver 1.0' causes errors.

You haven't specified the old and new names. Note that the project name must not exceed 8 characters. The following characters are disallowed in project names: < (less than), > (greater than), :, " (quotes), / (forward slash), \ (backslash), | (vertical line), ? (question mark), * (asterisk).

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter issues renaming web editor project folders for [product_name] when using unsupported characters or when the name exceeds eight characters. These errors aren't clearly explained in the product, so users rely on trial and error to figure out acceptable conventions. Many only learn about restrictions like character limits or forbidden symbols after errors occur.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the freedom to rename project folders and expect clear, immediate feedback if a chosen name does not meet requirements. They anticipate explicit guidance on valid names and proactive error messages that help prevent upload failures.
